description: Add an Option-A receipt-download capability: a new Strands @tool get_receipt_url(order_id) that generates the SAME 15-minute SigV4 regional presigned GET for receipts/{order_id}.pdf as the presign Lambda, via a SHARED signing helper (ONE copy of the signing code). The link is surfaced through the authoritative req_ctx side channel into a top-level `receipt` object in the HTTP envelope (never parsed from model text) and rendered as a clickable 'Download receipt' link in the SPA. Includes the IAM/env grants on the assistant role, unit tests, and the mandatory ECR image rebuild+push on deploy. Independent of FEAT-001 (no shared files). Option A chosen over Option B (call back through API Gateway/CloudFront+WAF) for least blast radius and best security: in-process signing, a narrow s3:GetObject grant, no edge round-trip, kms:Decrypt already present on the assistant role.
steps: Refactor app/presign/handler.py: add make_s3_presign_client(region=None) that returns the boto3.client('s3', region_name=region or os.environ.get('AWS_REGION_PINNED','ap-southeast-1'), endpoint_url=f'https://s3.{region}.amazonaws.com', config=Config(signature_version='s3v4', s3={'addressing_style':'virtual'})) currently built INLINE in handler(); change handler() to call it. Keep generate_url, ORDER_ID_RE, EXPIRES_IN=900 as the single source of truth. Preserve the existing guarded boto3/Config import so the module imports without boto3.

Add make_get_receipt_url(req_ctx, bucket, region=None, orders_table=None) to app/assistant/tools.py returning an inner @tool get_receipt_url(order_id) that mirrors the existing factories: validate with pii.validate_order_id (on failure return {'status':'REJECTED','reason':'invalid order id format'} and append NOTHING); if orders_table is bound, GetItem and return {'status':'NOT_FOUND','orderId':order_id} when absent (format validation is the minimum); build the client via presign.handler.make_s3_presign_client(region) and the URL via presign.handler.generate_url(client, bucket, order_id); on success append {'orderId':order_id,'url':url,'expiresIn':EXPIRES_IN} to req_ctx.setdefault('receipts', []) and return {'status':'OK','orderId':order_id,'url':url,'expiresIn':EXPIRES_IN}. Import the presign helpers defensively (guarded, mirroring the existing try/except at module top) so tools.py stays importable without boto3/strands. Never read the URL from model output.

Wire the tool in app/assistant/handler.py: import make_get_receipt_url from .tools; in handler() initialize req_ctx = {'pending_refunds': [], 'placed_orders': [], 'receipts': []}; in _build_agent read bucket=os.environ['RECEIPTS_BUCKET'] and region=os.environ.get('AWS_REGION_PINNED','ap-southeast-1'), build get_receipt_url=make_get_receipt_url(req_ctx, bucket, region, orders_table) and add it to the Agent tools=[...] list; extend build_response() to add a top-level body['receipt'] = {orderId,url,expiresIn} from req_ctx['receipts'][-1] when non-empty (same pattern as pendingRefund/placedOrder).

Extend app/tests/test_tools.py (mock S3; no real AWS): valid order id -> status OK, a url is returned, and req_ctx['receipts'][-1] == {orderId,url,expiresIn}; invalid order id -> REJECTED and req_ctx['receipts'] == []. Inject a fake presign client by monkeypatching presign.handler.make_s3_presign_client to return a FakeS3 (like test_presign.py's FakeS3). Keep the strands-free / @tool-guarded style.
Extend app/tests/test_handler.py: assert build_response adds a top-level 'receipt' object when req_ctx['receipts'] is non-empty and omits it when empty.

Edit infra/lib/app-edge-ai-stack.ts: add RECEIPTS_BUCKET: receiptsBucket.bucketName to the AssistantFn environment map; add an iam.PolicyStatement on assistantRole granting s3:GetObject on receiptsBucket.arnForObjects('*') (mirror the presignRole 'ReadReceipts' statement). Add a comment that kms:Decrypt is already covered by the existing kmsKey.grantEncryptDecrypt(assistantRole) so no new KMS grant is required. (receiptsBucket is already declared before the Lambda section — confirm no forward reference.)

Render the link in spa/app.js: add a renderReceipt(receipt) helper (mirror renderPendingRefund, build DOM via createElement + textContent, set anchor href=receipt.url, target='_blank', rel='noopener', label 'Download receipt'); in sendMessage, after the data.placedOrder branch, add `if (data.receipt && data.receipt.url) renderReceipt(data.receipt);`. Add minimal CSS in spa/styles.css reusing existing look (e.g. a .receipt block styled like .pending and a link/button style consistent with existing buttons). No index.html change required.
Run the full local verification suite (see verification) and confirm the baseline invariants: pytest count > 45 all green; npm test only the known invocation-logging failure.

Deploy (do NOT modify deploy.sh/destroy.sh): (a) cd infra && CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=875692608981 CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=ap-southeast-1 npx cdk deploy SecureAssistantAppEdgeAI --require-approval never AFTER the MANDATORY ECR image rebuild+push, because app/assistant/*.py changed and `cdk deploy` does NOT rebuild the image. Image rebuild (deploy.sh step 3b): ACCOUNT_ID=875692608981; AWS_REGION=ap-southeast-1; REPO=session5-secure-assistant; URI=${ACCOUNT_ID}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION}.amazonaws.com/${REPO}; aws ecr get-login-password --region ${AWS_REGION} | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin ${ACCOUNT_ID}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION}.amazonaws.com; BUILDX_NO_DEFAULT_ATTESTATIONS=1 docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --provenance=false --sbom=false -t ${URI}:latest --push /home/ubuntu/apcr-dva/demo/session5-secure-assistant/app. Then, if the AssistantFn CFN resource did not change (ECR :latest tag reused), force the new image: aws lambda update-function-code --function-name <AssistantFn physical name> --image-uri ${URI}:latest --region ap-southeast-1 (resolve the name via aws cloudformation describe-stack-resources --stack-name SecureAssistantAppEdgeAI --query "StackResources[?ResourceType=='AWS::Lambda::Function' && contains(LogicalResourceId,'AssistantFn')].PhysicalResourceId" --output text).
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m pytest app/tests -q passes with MORE than 45 tests (new receipt-tool + build_response tests included), and the new tests assert: valid id -> url returned + req_ctx['receipts'] populated; invalid id -> REJECTED + req_ctx['receipts'] empty; build_response includes 'receipt' only when the side channel is non-empty.

There is exactly ONE copy of the SigV4+regional signing code: both presign/handler.handler and assistant tools.get_receipt_url obtain their client from presign.handler.make_s3_presign_client and build the URL via presign.handler.generate_url.
python3 -m py_compile across app/ succeeds and node --check spa/app.js parses clean; the modules still import without boto3/strands installed.

cd infra && npx tsc --noEmit compiles and npm test still passes everything except the single known invocation-logging failure; the AssistantFn env includes RECEIPTS_BUCKET and the assistant role has an s3:GetObject statement on the receipts objects ARN.

The presign security model is unchanged: 15-minute (EXPIRES_IN=900) SigV4 regional presigned GET for receipts/{orderId}.pdf only, order-id validated, private bucket, no OAC/TLS-deny changes; URLs come only from the req_ctx side channel, never from model text.
On deploy, the assistant ECR image is rebuilt+pushed before/with the AppEdgeAI deploy and the running AssistantFn serves the new image.
verification: cd /home/ubuntu/apcr-dva/demo/session5-secure-assistant/infra && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test   # only the known invocation-logging assertion may fail
findings: IMPLEMENTED (Option A). (1) app/presign/handler.py: added make_s3_presign_client(region=None) as the SINGLE source of the SigV4+regional-addressing S3 client (signature_version s3v4, virtual addressing, endpoint https://s3.<region>.amazonaws.com, region from arg or AWS_REGION_PINNED/ap-southeast-1); handler() now calls it. generate_url/ORDER_ID_RE/EXPIRES_IN(=900) unchanged and still the single URL builder. Guarded boto3/Config import preserved. (2) app/assistant/tools.py: guarded `from presign import handler as presign_handler` + EXPIRES_IN (falls back to 15*60 when boto3 absent); added make_get_receipt_url(req_ctx, bucket, region=None, orders_table=None) returning @tool get_receipt_url(order_id): validates via pii.validate_order_id (REJECTED appends nothing); if orders_table bound and item missing -> NOT_FOUND; else builds client via presign_handler.make_s3_presign_client(region) + url via presign_handler.generate_url(client,bucket,order_id); on success appends {orderId,url,expiresIn} to req_ctx['receipts'] and returns status OK. URL never read from model text. (3) app/assistant/handler.py: imports make_get_receipt_url; req_ctx now {'pending_refunds','placed_orders','receipts'}; _build_agent reads RECEIPTS_BUCKET + AWS_REGION_PINNED, builds the tool and adds it to Agent tools=[...]; build_response adds top-level body['receipt']={orderId,url,expiresIn} from req_ctx['receipts'][-1] only when non-empty. (4) app/tests/test_tools.py: +2 tests (valid id -> OK + url + side channel populated via monkeypatched make_s3_presign_client -> FakeS3; invalid id -> REJECTED + receipts empty). app/tests/test_handler.py: +2 tests (receipt present only when side channel non-empty; side-channel url wins over model text). (5) infra/lib/app-edge-ai-stack.ts: added RECEIPTS_BUCKET env to AssistantFn and an s3:GetObject 'ReadReceipts' statement on assistantRole scoped to receiptsBucket.arnForObjects('*'); comment notes kms:Decrypt already granted via kmsKey.grantEncryptDecrypt(assistantRole); no forward reference (receiptsBucket declared earlier). (6) spa/app.js: added renderReceipt(receipt) (createElement+textContent, anchor href=receipt.url target=_blank rel=noopener label 'Download receipt'); sendMessage calls it after the placedOrder branch when data.receipt.url present. spa/styles.css: styled .receipt anchor as a button consistent with .pending/.chat (the .receipt block already existed). Presign security model unchanged (15-min SigV4 regional GET, receipts/{orderId}.pdf only, order-id validated, private bucket). EXACTLY ONE copy of the signing config (grep signature_version -> only presign/handler.py). VERIFICATION (all pass): py_compile clean; pytest = 49 passed (was 45, +4); node --check spa/app.js clean; tsc --noEmit clean; npm test fails ONLY the single known AWS::Bedrock::ModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration invocation-logging assertion (baseline, unchanged) and no other assertion regressed. DEPLOYED: YES. Ran the MANDATORY ECR rebuild+push first (docker buildx --provenance=false --sbom=false --platform linux/amd64 to 875692608981.dkr.ecr.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/session5-secure-assistant:latest), then `cdk deploy SecureAssistantAppEdgeAI --exclusively --require-approval never` (used --exclusively because a plain `cdk deploy` tried to update the unmodified SecurityData dependency stack and hit a pre-existing AWS::EarlyValidation::PropertyValidation hook failure that is OUT OF SCOPE for FEAT-002; AppEdgeAI is the only stack this feature changes). AppEdgeAI deployed successfully. Then forced the new image onto the running function: aws lambda update-function-code --function-name SecureAssistantAppEdgeAI-AssistantFn15314C76-ngCufWRKrwOi --image-uri <repo>:latest; waited for function-updated -> LastUpdateStatus Successful and confirmed RECEIPTS_BUCKET=secureassistantappedgeai-receiptsbucket913676d9-hflwjvthyqlq is live on AssistantFn. NOTE for later steps: the SecurityData stack currently fails an Early-Validation changeset hook on a plain `cdk deploy --all`; if a later step must deploy SecurityData, investigate that hook separately (it is unrelated to FEAT-002's AppEdgeAI-only changes). Did NOT touch deploy.sh/destroy.sh, custom domain/ACM/Route53/WAF/PrivateLink, or region pinning.
